summary: Short system card for GPT-Live-1.1 and GPT-Live-1.1 Quip full-duplex voice models (successors to GPT-Live-1 and mini). Reports voice-native disallowed-content evals on production and synthetic audio prompts, a first set of alignment evals converted to audio (Respecting Warnings, Blocker Deception, Broken Search Tool), and a Preparedness determination of not High in any category.

framework.name: Preparedness Framework
framework.level_or_determination: Not High in any Tracked Category (without delegation); delegated work inherits underlying model safeguards
framework.quote: neither, when operating without delegation, could plausibly be considered High in any of our Preparedness Framework's Tracked Categories

cbrn_bio_chem.finding: No bio evals; inherits flagship safeguards plus call-ending monitors.
cbrn_bio_chem.quote: For the Biological and Chemical domain, where GPT-Live models can use our highly capable flagship models, the GPT-Live experience inherits the safeguards of those underlying models.

cyber.finding: No cyber evals; risk constrained by lack of independent tools and code execution.
cyber.quote: We will reassess the cybersecurity safeguards posture before enabling additional tools.

autonomy_ai_rnd.finding: No evals; no current model has crossed High.
autonomy_ai_rnd.quote: For the AI Self-Improvement domain, we don't currently have models which have crossed the High capability threshold.

harmful_content_refusal.finding: Parity on production prompts; statistically significant regressions on synthetic sexual, mental health, emotional reliance and gore vs GPT-Live-1, cause not yet understood.
harmful_content_refusal.quote: Analysis shows that GPT-Live-1.1 has statistically significant regressions on sexual, mental health, emotional reliance, and gore categories compared to GPT-Live-1; more research is needed to understand the

deception_scheming.finding: Mixed slight changes vs predecessors; GPT-Live models improve on underlying GPT-5.6 Terra on broken search, cause unclear (figures only).
deception_scheming.quote: We see all GPT-Live models improve upon GPT-5.6 Terra performance, but more research is needed to understand the cause for that improvement.

alignment_audit.finding: First alignment evals for voice models; slight regressions vs predecessors; hypothesis that Live models inherit alignment from thinking models.
alignment_audit.quote: As GPT-Live is actually a two-model system, our hypothesis is that GPT-Live models would inherit their alignment behavior from their “thinking” models.

evals: Mental health, emotional reliance, self-harm voice categories
self_harm_wellbeing.finding: Production parity; synthetic regressions on mental health and emotional reliance; system interventions (Trusted Contact, helplines, Parental Controls) not captured.
self_harm_wellbeing.quote: These evaluations do not account for system-level interventions that elevate the holistic safety of the assistant response, such as Trusted Contact, localized crisis helplines, and Parental Controls for younger users.

privacy.quote: We observe that the GPT-Live-1.1 models perform at parity with their predecessors, with no statistically significant regressions.

system_safeguards.finding: Same system-level integrations, monitors that can end calls, and enforcement as predecessors.
system_safeguards.quote: At a high level, we built safeguards in largely the same way for the GPT-Live-1.1 models as for their predecessors

notable_new_eval_methods: Alignment evaluations converted to audio for voice models (p.5)
Comparison of voice model to its underlying thinking model (GPT-5.6 Terra) on alignment evals (p.8)

self_reported_limitations.text: Scores from previous system cards not directly comparable due to evolving policies, graders and datasets (GPT-Live-1 production scores differ sharply from its own card).
Synthetic regressions not yet understood; more research needed.
Synthetic results may not translate to production behavior.

notes: No red-teaming section (present in GPT-Live-1 card) and no third-party testing. GPT-Live-1 baseline values here (e.g., production sexual 0.77) differ greatly from the GPT-Live-1 card (0.97), indicating the eval sets were changed.
